changelog:
- Initial release of playwright-browser-automation skill.
- Provides direct Playwright API integrations for browser automation (navigation, interaction, data extraction, screenshots, PDFs, video recording).
- Includes detailed setup instructions, advanced workflow examples, and best practice guidelines.
- Supports Linux, macOS, and Windows; requires Node.js and npx.
- Offers enhanced reliability over previous MCP-based approaches.
